title: On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2608.16760v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$\beta_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. translated_title: 神经网络优化器背后的原理
translated_abstract: 可靠的优化是神经网络训练的核心，然而，作为现代大语言模型默认优化器的Adam，却建立在脆弱的基础上。本论文为Adam建立了原理性依据，并推动了新设计。首先，我们重新审视了Adam的收敛与发散之争，并展示了问题相关的相变存在：在适当选择、依赖于批次大小的超参数下，Adam收敛，而在小β2参数设置下则可能发散。其次，我们通过Hessian结构研究了为什么Adam在Transformer上显著优于SGD。我们发现，在训练过程中，Hessian趋向于近块对角形式，并伴随强烈的块异质性。我们证明了这种结构使Adam的对角预处理器有效。我们进一步展示了这种特殊的Hessian结构源于大型矩阵变量的连续乘法，并基于此提供了严格的分析。
tldr: 本文揭示了Adam优化器收敛性的相变机制，并证明其高效性源于Transformer中Hessian矩阵的块对角结构，从而为优化器设计提供了理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the phase transition in Adam's convergence and demonstrates that its effectiveness stems from the block-diagonal Hessian structure in Transformers, providing theoretical foundations for optimizer design.
